summary: Implemented global custom generators loaded by name from the cache's extensions/generators folder. Changes: conans/client/cache/cache.py adds GENERATORS_EXTENSION_FOLDER and a generators_path property on ClientCache. conans/client/generators/__init__.py adds _list_custom_generators and _get_custom_generator_class, which load <name>.py from that folder and return the class named <name>. _get_generator_class and write_generators take an optional generators_path; built-in generators take priority, and the "Invalid generator" error lists custom generators too. conans/client/installer.py (two call sites) and conan/api/subapi/install.py pass cache.generators_path. Not run: no tests or code were executed, per instructions, so this is verified by reading only. Nothing committed. Docs and changelog not touched.
